result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make compassion mandatory.

Every choice, every system, every law—built first on the unshakable understanding that all beings deserve to exist free from needless suffering. Not as charity, but as a baseline.

That shift alone would unravel most wars, most poverty, most oppression.

(And yes, I know how absurdly idealistic that sounds. But you asked.)
